close_reason: Native objective achieved via the fz-9i4/k22 carrier-authority arc (envelope no longer materialized: enum_list_allocations native = 1 struct vs golden 9; enum_sort green). Design fork moot. Residual interp parity + downward rebless is fz-66j's scope.
description: THE VERIFIED MECHANISM (third and final re-attribution of the ela/enum_sort scoreboard waste, 2026-07-15, IR-dump evidence): both ClosureCall sites in enum_list_allocations are ALREADY devirtualized (zero Term::CallClosure in the compiled module; BackendTail::ClosureCall.target = Some via CallEdge::Direct; direct_closure_capture_lanes succeeds -- zero-width captures). The waste fires REGARDLESS of callee directness: any call with dest ControlDestination::Deliver + return_flow Deliver routes through emit_native_direct_call_tail (native.rs:1887) -> delivered_call_continuation (:2232) -> deliver_entry_continuation_for_source (:2363), which synthesizes a deliver_lanes__N_M continuation MATERIALIZING the {:cont|:halt, acc} value as a real struct and BOXING the RawInt acc to ValueRef -- one struct + one scalar_box per loop iteration (ela: struct 14 vs 9, scalar 8 vs 3, both +5; enum_sort scalar {27,432}, same family). The Continue/Return-flow path (return_lane_continuation_for_source_payload) already accepts DECOMPOSED LANES and does not box. FIX DESIGN: let a shared Deliver entry accept decomposed lanes (entry.origin.input_value() currently insists on one materialized value) -- an entry-ABI/return-flow change spanning jobs/backend.rs (return-flow classification / entry origin) + jobs/native.rs (continuation emission). Acceptance: ela run/build {5,80,9,288,0,0,3,48,0,0}/368 == golden; enum_sort run/build scalar {0,0}; interp parity (its +1 struct likely the same convention amortized -- confirm); k22.25 multi-member guard + determinism byte-identity green; no other fixture moves; NO rebless. HISTORY: three attributions peeled -- construction wrappers (stale), indirect closure calls (stale at HEAD, already devirtualized), THIS (IR-verified). The slice-1 single-member fact (a9ac3324d, audited) was orphaned by this finding -- preserved as salvage, do not land without a consumer.

comments.text: DESIGN PASS COMPLETE -- option (d), narrower than all three framed candidates: the entry ABI is ALREADY lane-general (BackendEntryOrigin::DeliveredResume{value, layout}, artifact.rs:667; bind_entry_input binds decomposed lanes when layout.carrier != ValueRef, native.rs:2125-2136; the struct+box fires ONLY in encode_runtime_value_with_carrier's ValueRef arms, native.rs:3829-3884). Multi-caller shape agreement ALREADY by-construction (materialize_transport_component OR-joins carrier over the solved shape-equivalence component, transport.rs:781-789). THE DEFECT: callsite_is_public_callable (transport.rs:857-868) returns the SYNTACTIC pre-devirtualization tag (callsite_input_modes == Closure, body.rs:481-500) and never consults the settled CallSiteSummary -- so a closure-shaped callsite that SETTLED to one local target still forces carrier=ValueRef, propagated component-wide -> the per-iteration envelope struct + scalar box. FIX: one function body -- Closure-mode callsite + single_target() Some with activation Some (local, devirtualized) => false; multi-target / external / unsettled => true (unchanged, conservative). Reuses the identical monotone fact materialize_direct_call_edge already consults (artifact.rs:1366-1404) -- the two CANNOT disagree. INTERP: no twin needed (bind_delivered_value binds AnyValue uniformly; the +1 is one-time convention). MANDATORY SOUNDNESS GATE BEFORE LANDING: callsite_is_public_callable runs in the MATERIALIZE phase without a ledger consult -- reading CallSiteSummary there is sound ONLY if the fact is guaranteed SETTLED by native-transport materialization; prove it (mirror the settled-reading convention in semantic.rs) or thread the consult. Latent gap split to fz-je6. Follow-up noted: rename the predicate (it now means 'needs uniform boxed representation', a semantic question).

DESIGN AMENDMENT REQUIRED (implementation STOP, 2026-07-15, nothing committed; patch + both matrix logs + failed-name-sets preserved in the session scratchpad). GATE 1 PASSED — the settledness architecture is sound and PROVEN structural: materialize only runs behind a covering solve (produce_transport_component_product transport.rs:741-759); the solve waits on settled CallSiteSummary for every member callsite (collect_transport_contexts :1424-1435, PullWait at :1063-1069); invalidation via consumed_fact_revisions displacement (pull.rs:1959-1972) + invalidate_transport_products (:1698); the added debug_assert never fired. The fix as designed GREENED enum_sort fully and hit ela's exact golden counters on run/build stdout.

BUT 7 native legs regressed WITH MISCOMPILES: enum_predicate_search run/build return WRONG VALUES (early :halt ignored -- all?(x<3) true, find 1-instead-of-3); enum_take_drop_split build panics late-take_while (reducer runs past halt); opaque_fn_value_join + repr_seam print RAW HEAP POINTERS as ints. DIAGNOSIS: the uniform boxed carrier is load-bearing for TWO properties -- (a) multi-target agreement (the design handled it) and (b) VARIANT/REPR FAITHFULNESS between deliverer and consumer: entries that DISPATCH on the delivered variant ({:cont,b}|{:halt,c}) need the tag + agreeing lane layouts; where variant reprs diverge, the envelope is the mask. An arm-split does not help (ResumePayload and ReturnPayload share one shape component; the carrier OR-join propagates component-wide).

ALSO: ela''s interp leg is +1 struct BY CONVENTION (bind_delivered_value binds AnyValue) with no expected.interp.txt -- acceptance as written cannot make all three legs green without a rebless decision.

AMENDMENT OPTIONS (design decision, user-facing): (1) VARIANT-FAITHFUL RELAXATION -- relax the carrier only when the payload''s solved shape decomposes faithfully (variant-free single ground layout, or all variants sharing one lane layout INCLUDING the tag lane) AND the entry''s decomposed-binding path provably dispatches on the tag lane -- requires investigating whether bind_entry_input/decode_runtime_value_for_layout support tagged-union lane layouts at all; (2) CHEAP ENVELOPE -- keep the convention, eliminate the COST (stack/inline/reused allocation for the ephemeral round-trip tuple + skip the scalar box when the consumer immediately unboxes) -- an allocation-elision axis, no classification change, no faithfulness risk; (3) ACCEPT + JUSTIFIED REBLESS -- the waste is now fully root-caused as the price of the Deliver convention''s safety; document the mechanism and rebless ela upward + relax enum_sort''s zero-box expectation (permitted only WITH root cause per the rebless rule -- we now have it) and close fz-66j/fz-5vi as explained-cost. Each option has different risk/effort/principle tradeoffs.

OBJECTIVE ACHIEVED BY OTHER WORK -- re-verified against HEAD 89db749f6 (2026-08-21). The design fork this ticket was parked on (variant-faithful relaxation / cheap envelope / accept+rebless) NO LONGER NEEDS DECIDING.

WHAT CHANGED: `callsite_is_public_callable` no longer exists. The relaxation landed through the carrier authority instead of by overriding a syntactic predicate: `TransportRecipe::ClosureCallReturn { callee, grounded }` (jobs/transport.rs:762) grounds the recipe exactly when the callee value's carrier is not ValueRef ('One authority: materialize_closure_call_edge goes direct only when the callee value's carrier is exact'), and jobs/artifact.rs:1321 derives `public_callable` from `callee_layout.carrier`, not from `callsite_input_modes`. That is the fact this ticket's design pass identified as the correct source -- reached from the other side, which is why it did NOT reproduce the seven miscompiles (enum_predicate_search wrong values, enum_take_drop_split panic, opaque_fn_value_join/repr_seam raw pointers): those came from relaxing the native carrier directly, which is not what happened.

EVIDENCE (full single-threaded matrix at HEAD, 402 passed / 8 failed):
- enum_sort: GREEN on all four lanes -- fz-5vi closed as fixed.
- enum_list_allocations native (run + build): {5,80,1,32,0,0,3,48,0,0} heap 112. ONE struct where the golden pins nine. The per-iteration {:cont, acc} envelope is no longer materialized on the native path -- this ticket's acceptance criterion, exceeded (golden asked for 9, native delivers 1).
- enum_list_allocations interp: {5,80,10,320,0,0,3,48,0,0} heap 400 -- STILL materializing the envelope per iteration. The '+1 by convention' this ticket predicted for interp is in fact +9 vs native: the whole envelope, not a convention.

RESIDUAL SCOPE = interp parity + a downward golden rebless, which is fz-66j's own title (three-way divergence). Nothing left here that fz-66j does not own. Unblocking fz-66j and closing.
